messages.content: By how much did the total amount charged for care, before any reimbursement, change from claims processed in January 2025 to claims processed in February 2025? Return February's total minus January's.

input.sql: select FLX_ANN_MOI, count(*), sum(PRS_PAI_MNT), sum(FLT_PAI_MNT), sum(PRS_REM_MNT) from ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS where FLX_ANN_MOI in (202501,202502) group by 1

input.final_sql: select sum(case when FLX_ANN_MOI=202502 then PRS_PAI_MNT end) - sum(case when FLX_ANN_MOI=202501 then PRS_PAI_MNT end) as diff from ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS where FLX_ANN_MOI in (202501,202502)
